description: OrangeHRM open-source demo - an HR management system. Login, dashboard, and the Admin / PIM modules. Angular SPA: `oxd-*` classes are design-system names (stable), not generated hashes.

_inventory_conventions.selectors: Every selector maps to a first-class Playwright locator: [name='x'] / #id (css), role=button[name='Save'] (getByRole), label=X (getByLabel), placeholder=..., alt=..., title=..., text=... . XPath is never emitted. An iframe-chained selector uses ' >>> '. label=/alt=/title= need page.get_by_label/get_by_alt_text/get_by_title - they are NOT page.locator() engine syntax; role= and text= work with page.locator().
_inventory_conventions.shared_navigation: The left menu and top bar appear on EVERY page after login. They live once under the `menu` page (always: true) instead of being repeated on each page, which is what the raw crawl produced.
_inventory_conventions.form_fields: OrangeHRM's form inputs carry no name or id - Angular renders them bare. The crawler therefore fell back to 12-level css paths that break on any layout change. They are replaced here with `.oxd-input-group:has-text('Label') input`, which anchors on the visible label text and survives re-layout. VERIFY these with `python -m scripts.verify_locators` before trusting them.
_inventory_conventions.verification: Captured by scripts/generate_inventory.py against the live app, then hand-reviewed: pages renamed, navigation de-duplicated, brittle css paths replaced, and elements a crawler cannot see (validation messages, dropdown options) added by hand.

common_errors.password_no_number: Your password must contain minimum 1 number
common_errors.password_no_lowercase: Your password must contain minimum 1 lower-case letter
common_errors.password_has_spaces: Your password should not contain spaces

elements_notes.error_banner: Shown for WRONG credentials. Text is exactly 'Invalid credentials' — the app does not say which field was wrong, deliberately.
elements_notes.field_error: MATCHES EVERY field error on the page. Use ONLY for counting or for 'is any error shown' checks - never with a visibility assertion, which raises a Playwright strict mode violation when two fields are empty. For a single field use username_field_error / password_field_error; for 'the first one' use field_error_first.
elements_notes.credentials_hint: The demo prints Admin / admin123 on the login screen itself.
elements_notes.field_error_first: The generic field_error narrowed to one element with >> nth=0. Safe with wait_visible. Order-dependent: nth=0 is Username, nth=1 is Password.
elements_notes.username_field_error: Scoped to the Username input group, so it stays unique even when both fields are empty. Preferred over field_error for per-field assertions.
elements_notes.password_field_error: Scoped to the Password input group. Unique on the LOGIN form because no other group there contains the word 'Password'. Note this is NOT true on Add User, where 'Confirm Password' also matches - see that page's keys.

elements_notes.header_title: Breadcrumb heading. Reads 'Dashboard' here and the module name elsewhere — the cheapest proof that login succeeded.
elements_notes.logout_link: Only rendered AFTER user_dropdown is clicked. A crawler cannot see it; it is listed here from manual review.

elements_notes.always: `always: true` means this page is injected regardless of the story's Component - the menu is reachable from every authenticated page.
elements_notes.logout_link: Rendered only AFTER user_dropdown is clicked. The crawler cannot see it; added by hand. MenuPage.logout() opens the dropdown first.
elements_notes.toast: Success/error toast, e.g. 'Successfully Saved'. Present in the DOM but empty until an action fires.

elements_notes.add_button: OrangeHRM pads button labels with spaces - the accessible name is ' Add ', not 'Add'. Matching on 'Add' alone will not resolve.
elements_notes.user_role_filter: User Role / Status filters are custom ARIA dropdowns, not <select>. They must be CLICKED open before their options exist in the DOM, so the crawler never saw the options.
elements_notes.shared_demo: This is a PUBLIC demo - other people add and delete users while your tests run. Never assert on a record count or on a specific user existing unless the test created it.

elements_notes.SELECTORS_REPLACED: The crawl produced 12-level css paths for every form field (#app > div:nth-of-type(1) > ...) because Angular renders these inputs with no name or id. Those break on any layout change and were replaced with label-anchored selectors. VERIFY with `python -m scripts.verify_locators --url '/web/index.php/admin/saveSystemUser'` before relying on them.
elements_notes.field_error: THE KEY ELEMENT FOR VALIDATION TESTS, and the crawler never saw it - it renders only after a field is touched and left invalid. Messages appear AS YOU TYPE, not on Save, so a test must assert after filling the field, not after submitting the form. MATCHES EVERY field error on the page: use only for counting or 'is any error shown'. For per-field assertions use password_field_error / confirm_password_field_error.
elements_notes.password_input: Password and Confirm Password are both bare `input[type='password']` in DOM order. nth=0/nth=1 is positional and would break if the form gained another password field - acceptable here because the form is fixed, but worth re-checking after an OrangeHRM upgrade.
elements_notes.user_role_select: Custom ARIA dropdown, NOT a <select>. Click it, then click an `.oxd-select-option`. `select_option()` will not work.
elements_notes.employee_name_input: Autocomplete. Type at least 2 characters, wait for `.oxd-autocomplete-option`, then click one. Typing a full name without selecting a suggestion leaves the field invalid.
elements_notes.do_not_save: This is a PUBLIC shared demo. A saved user persists and the next run hits 'User already exists'. Validation-only tests that never click Save are safe; anything that saves needs a unique username per run.
elements_notes.password_field_error: Scoped to the Password input group. ':has-text' is a SUBSTRING match, so it also matches the Confirm Password group - hence '>> nth=0'. The Password group precedes Confirm Password in the form, so nth=0 is Password. Same nth convention as password_input.
elements_notes.confirm_password_field_error: Scoped to the Confirm Password input group. Needs no nth: 'Confirm Password' is a substring of that group only.

errors.password_no_number: Your password must contain minimum 1 number
errors.password_no_lowercase: Your password must contain minimum 1 lower-case letter
errors.password_has_spaces: Your password should not contain spaces

elements_notes.filters: Every *_select here is a custom ARIA dropdown, not a <select>. Click to open, then click an `.oxd-select-option`.
elements_notes.records_found: Reads '(N) Records Found'. On this SHARED demo the number changes as other people add and delete employees - assert that results are filtered, never on an exact count.
elements_notes.crawl_noise: The raw crawl produced 265 elements for this page, almost all of them the left menu and per-row action buttons. Only the search form and results container are kept here.
